title: Asean parliamentary bloc yet to address AI guardrails, says lawmaker

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The parliamentary grouping of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) has not yet discussed how to govern artificial intelligence and set guardrails or governing rules. This information comes from House Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand Hernandez said on Wednesday. The lawmaker called the frontier technology a “growing concern.” Hernandez is head of the Philippine delegation to Asean Inter-parliamentary Assembly (AIPA). He said, “We haven’t discussed in detail as to what will be the direction as far as AI” is concerned.” But he underscored that “it’s a growing concern, and I think it cannot be addressed by one country.” […]...
